blocks.md:
고정한 특성 추출부는 이미지를 64개 숫자로 바꾸는 "특징 생성기"이기도 합니다. 이 특징을 3단계에서 배운 scikit-learn 모델에 넣을 수도 있습니다(도전 문제).

`with torch.no_grad(): feats = model.features(X).numpy()`처럼 NumPy 배열로 꺼내면 됩니다.

blocks.code:
import torch
from torch import nn

features = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(1, 4, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(), nn.MaxPool2d(2), nn.Flatten())
with torch.no_grad():
    feats = features(torch.zeros(3, 1, 8, 8)).numpy()
print(type(feats).__name__, feats.shape)

exercises.title: 전이 학습 전 과정
exercises.prompt_md: ① `pretrained()`의 state_dict를 `io.BytesIO`에 저장 ② `torch.manual_seed(2)` 후 새 `Net(5)`를 만들어 불러오기 ③ `features` 고정 ④ `torch.manual_seed(1)` 후 `fc`를 `nn.Linear(64, 5)`로 교체 ⑤ `few_shot(seed, per_class)` 학습 데이터로 `fit(..., 40)`. `[학습 가능 매개변수 수, 테스트 정확도(소수 넷째 자리)]`를 반환하세요.
exercises.starter_code:
import io
import torch
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from torch import nn, optim


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_out):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 8, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(), nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(8, 16, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(), nn.MaxPool2d(2), nn.Flatten(),
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(64, n_out)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.fc(self.features(x))


def all_digits():
    digits = load_digits()
    X = torch.tensor(digits.images, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(1) / 16
    return X, torch.tensor(digits.target)


def fit(model, X, y, epochs, lr=0.01):
    params = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
    optimizer = optim.Adam(params, lr=lr)
    for _ in range(epochs):
        loss = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(model(X), y)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
    return loss.item()


def accuracy(model, X, y):
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        acc = (model(X).argmax(dim=1) == y).float().mean().item()
    model.train()
    return acc


def pretrained():
    X, y = all_digits()
    keep = y < 5
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    model = Net(5)
    fit(model, X[keep], y[keep], 60)
    return model


def few_shot(seed, per_class):
    X, y = all_digits()
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
    train_idx, test_idx = [], []
    for digit in range(5, 10):
        idx = torch.nonzero(y == digit).flatten()
        idx = idx[torch.randperm(len(idx), generator=g)]
        train_idx += idx[:per_class].tolist()
        test_idx += idx[per_class:].tolist()
    return X[train_idx], y[train_idx] - 5, X[test_idx], y[test_idx] - 5

import io
import torch
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from torch import nn, optim


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_out):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 8, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(), nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(8, 16, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(), nn.MaxPool2d(2), nn.Flatten(),
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(64, n_out)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.fc(self.features(x))


def all_digits():
    digits = load_digits()
    X = torch.tensor(digits.images, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(1) / 16
    return X, torch.tensor(digits.target)


def fit(model, X, y, epochs, lr=0.01):
    params = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
    optimizer = optim.Adam(params, lr=lr)
    for _ in range(epochs):
        loss = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(model(X), y)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
    return loss.item()


def accuracy(model, X, y):
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        acc = (model(X).argmax(dim=1) == y).float().mean().item()
    model.train()
    return acc


def pretrained():
    X, y = all_digits()
    keep = y < 5
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    model = Net(5)
    fit(model, X[keep], y[keep], 60)
    return model


def few_shot(seed, per_class):
    X, y = all_digits()
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
    train_idx, test_idx = [], []
    for digit in range(5, 10):
        idx = torch.nonzero(y == digit).flatten()
        idx = idx[torch.randperm(len(idx), generator=g)]
        train_idx += idx[:per_class].tolist()
        test_idx += idx[per_class:].tolist()
    return X[train_idx], y[train_idx] - 5, X[test_idx], y[test_idx] - 5


def transfer_pipeline(seed, per_class):
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    torch.save(pretrained().state_dict(), buffer)
    buffer.seek(0)
    torch.manual_seed(2)
    model = Net(5)
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(buffer))
    for p in model.features.parameters():
        p.requires_grad = False
    torch.manual_seed(1)
    model.fc = nn.Linear(64, 5)
    X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test = few_shot(seed, per_class)
    fit(model, X_train, y_train, 40)
    trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    return [trainable, round(accuracy(model, X_test, y_test), 4)]

exercises.solution:
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
import torch
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from torch import nn, optim


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_out):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 8, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(), nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(8, 16, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(), nn.MaxPool2d(2), nn.Flatten(),
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(64, n_out)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.fc(self.features(x))


def all_digits():
    digits = load_digits()
    X = torch.tensor(digits.images, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(1) / 16
    return X, torch.tensor(digits.target)


def fit(model, X, y, epochs, lr=0.01):
    params = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
    optimizer = optim.Adam(params, lr=lr)
    for _ in range(epochs):
        loss = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(model(X), y)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
    return loss.item()


def accuracy(model, X, y):
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        acc = (model(X).argmax(dim=1) == y).float().mean().item()
    model.train()
    return acc


def pretrained():
    X, y = all_digits()
    keep = y < 5
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    model = Net(5)
    fit(model, X[keep], y[keep], 60)
    return model


def few_shot(seed, per_class):
    X, y = all_digits()
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
    train_idx, test_idx = [], []
    for digit in range(5, 10):
        idx = torch.nonzero(y == digit).flatten()
        idx = idx[torch.randperm(len(idx), generator=g)]
        train_idx += idx[:per_class].tolist()
        test_idx += idx[per_class:].tolist()
    return X[train_idx], y[train_idx] - 5, X[test_idx], y[test_idx] - 5


def features_vs_pixels(seed):
    X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test = few_shot(seed, 10)
    model = pretrained()
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        f_train, f_test = model.features(X_train).numpy(), model.features(X_test).numpy()
    results = {}
    for name, (A, B) in {"pixels": (X_train.flatten(1).numpy(), X_test.flatten(1).numpy()),
                         "features": (f_train, f_test)}.items():
        clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000).fit(A, y_train.numpy())
        results[name] = round(clf.score(B, y_test.numpy()), 4)
    return results
